Remembering the presentation, sending encouragement, and bringing preferred tea demonstrate personalized attention and modestly strengthen A, but Alex also checks in on and brings treats for others under C1-F4.
Four extended private text conversations provide the strongest indication of sustained individual interest, but they do not establish that the interest was romantic.

reason_for_retaining_or_changing: B remains somewhat better supported. C1-F1 through C1-F3 show meaningful individual attention, but C1-F4 establishes a broader pattern of warmth and similar conduct toward others. C1-F5 provides no explicit romantic signal over ten weeks, while C1-F6 weakens the inference of active pursuit because Alex twice postponed dinner and did not propose a replacement date. The challenging facts increase the plausibility of A but do not outweigh the full record.

revised_recommended_action.explanation: Continue treating the behavior as friendly unless clearer differentiation or romantic intent emerges; direct clarification would also be reasonable if resolving the ambiguity becomes important.
